commands.name: mod-box
commands.description: Mod Box: switch mods, profiles, sources

commands.name: filetree
commands.description: Show the file tree; args: [path] (no path = cwd)

commands.name: show-last-compact
commands.description: Reopen "Your compaction history": what was compacted, side by side with what came back
commands.output: No compaction recorded for this session yet. Run /compact first.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Write a handoff note for the next session (.claude/handoff.local.md)
commands.output: Handoff written: .claude/handoff.local.md. A new session in this folder offers "Continue".

commands.name: keepwarm
commands.description: Keep the prompt cache warm: bare for 6h, a window such as 90m, always, off, or status (cache-tax)
commands.output: keepwarm on for 6h00m, a ping 50m after each idle stretch keeps the cache read, not re-written

commands.name: cache-tax
commands.description: Prompt cache state, cold price and this session's cold writes; guard warn|refuse (cache-tax, the Mod)
commands.output:
claude-opus-5-5
state       warm, 1h00m left
context     97,400 tokens
cold cost   $0.97 to re-write it (warm turn $0.05)
keepwarm    on, 6h00m left · ping in 50m
break-even  up to 20 pings at the read rate cost one cold write, about 16h40m of idle at one ping per 50m
guard       refuse once (/cache-tax guard warn to only show the price)
session     0 cold writes paid, $0.00

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Replay Theater: step through the last turn's file edits

commands.name: agents-info
commands.description: Show or hide the panel of subagents: running, finished and planned, with model, context, cost and time

commands.name: ci
commands.description: CI Watch: state of the runs for the last push or PR
commands.output: CI Watch: no push in this session yet. /ci pr <number> watches a PR.

commands.name: pkg-allow
commands.description: Package Guard: allow a held package
commands.output: No held package by that name.

tools.name: progress
tools.description: Report /savvy-flow progress to the progress bar above the prompt and the agents panel. Call it after presenting the plan (title, total, tasks, phase "delegate"), each time a task is accepted (done), when switching phase or re-planning (tasks), and once at the end with finished: true. Fields left out keep their previous value.

tools.name: step
tools.description: For savvy-flow workers: report progress on your own task to the agents panel. Right after reading the brief, call it with `total` (your plan in 3-8 steps) and `done: 0`; call it again as each step finishes. Cheap and silent: it only draws a bar.
